items.title: Al Tinney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: Alexander — what was his name now — well anyhow—

ctx.x: That’s what you get for having rhythm. He knew that you could do it, right?

Well you know the funny thing, this is where I learned how to conduct. Because I was on the right stage up on the second floor and the conductor was right down below me. Alexander — what was his name now — well anyhow— © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
I had it written down. I can’t remember either. So you had to watch him?
